line_form: forge-gpu-run --min 30 --max <=1800 --label p1d-<line> -- timeout <=1750s env APA_P1D_ARM_B=<arm dir> python3 -B scripts/apa_p1d_gpu.py <mode> --out artifacts/apa_p1d/gpu/<line>
dry_run: each line once with FORGE_GPU_DRY_RUN=1 before its real run; expected exit 78
retry_rule: exit 76 = lock not acquired, nothing ran: retry unchanged after >= 5 min, at most 6 times, each recorded
comparison_rule: per output array: dtype and shape equal, then np.array_equal on same-width unsigned views; each side checked nonzero and non-constant at full width (L09, L19). Logs and timings are never compared.
